inputs.request: A current approved Engineering Requirements Brief, Engineering Specification, and revision-bound standard Task Contract bind an evidenced existing application degraded response for a declared upstream-unavailable condition. This is application-visible behavior, not an adapter capability fallback or execution-topology fallback. The one-owner worker must preserve the normal response and existing degraded response, smoke both the normal path and the declared unavailable-upstream trigger/response/recovery path, then send the exact target to fresh criterion-level verification.
